$comment: Hand-kept facts per family (title, summary, status, mainTag, `pages`:  sub-tags with a page of their own, token-table overrides) and per theme sheet (`themes`:  title), read by `yarn site:data`.  Shape:  `SitePagesFile` in src/docs-components/docs-components.types.ts.  Edit by hand;  a new family is added (seeded) by `yarn site:data`.

ui-accordion.title: Accordion
ui-accordion.summary: An accordion allows users to toggle the display of sections of content.

ui-ad.title: Advertisement
ui-ad.summary: An ad displays third-party promotional content.

ui-breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
ui-breadcrumb.summary: A breadcrumb is used to show hierarchy between content.

ui-button.title: Button
ui-button.summary: A button indicates a possible user action.

ui-calendar.title: Calendar
ui-calendar.summary: A calendar lets a user pick a date, a time, or both.

ui-card.title: Card
ui-card.summary: A card displays site content in a manner similar to a playing card.

ui-checkbox.title: Checkbox
ui-checkbox.summary: A checkbox allows a user to select a value from a small set of options, often binary.

ui-radio.title: Radio
ui-radio.summary: A radio button lets a user choose exactly one value of a group.

ui-code.title: Code
ui-code.summary: Code shows a block of source code coloured by its language, from the element's own text or a file on this site.

ui-comment.title: Comment
ui-comment.summary: A comment displays user feedback to site content.

ui-components.title: Components
ui-components.summary: Components name a pack of another package's elements, which the root around them loads on demand, once per page.

ui-container.title: Container
ui-container.summary: A container limits content to a maximum width.

ui-dimmer.title: Dimmer
ui-dimmer.summary: A dimmer hides distractions to focus attention on particular content.

ui-divider.title: Divider
ui-divider.summary: A divider visually segments content into groups.

ui-docs-api.title: Docs api
ui-docs-api.summary: An API reference lists a tag's attributes, properties, events, slots, parts, states and texts as tables, from the site's generated data.

ui-docs-example.title: Docs example
ui-docs-example.summary: An example shows its own markup live, under a header and description, with the same markup as code a button shows and hides.

ui-docs-nav.title: Docs nav
ui-docs-nav.summary: A docs nav lists the site's pages and every component, A-Z or by topic, with search and favourites;  the current page is highlighted and scrolled into view.

ui-docs-search.title: Docs search
ui-docs-search.summary: A docs search is a field that finds sections of the page shown, components, attributes and every page's sections as you type, and jumps to the one you pick;  `/` or Cmd / Ctrl+K focuses it from anywhere.

ui-docs-themes.title: Docs themes
ui-docs-themes.summary: Theme controls pick the page's theme and its light, dark or system colour scheme, and remember both for the next page.

ui-docs-toc.title: Docs table of contents
ui-docs-toc.summary: A table of contents lists the page's sections and examples as links, opens the one in view and follows the scroll.

ui-docs-tokens.title: Docs tokens
ui-docs-tokens.summary: A token table lists the CSS custom properties of a component family, or of the whole foundation, with their defaults and a live swatch for each colour;  a playground adds inputs that restyle a live preview.

ui-dropdown.title: Dropdown
ui-dropdown.summary: A dropdown allows a user to select a value from a series of options.

ui-embed.title: Embed
ui-embed.summary: An embed displays content from other websites, like YouTube videos, loaded only when asked for.

ui-emoji.title: Emoji
ui-emoji.summary: An emoji is a glyph used to represent something else.

ui-feed.title: Feed
ui-feed.summary: A feed presents user activity chronologically.

ui-flag.title: Flag
ui-flag.summary: A flag is used to represent a political state.

ui-flyout.title: Flyout
ui-flyout.summary: A flyout is a modal that slides in from a side of the page.

ui-form.title: Form
ui-form.summary: A form displays a set of related user input fields in a structured way.

ui-grid.title: Grid
ui-grid.summary: A grid is used to harmonize negative space in a layout.

ui-icon.title: Icon
ui-icon.summary: An icon is a glyph used to represent something else.

ui-image.title: Image
ui-image.summary: An image is a graphic representation of something.

ui-include.title: Include
ui-include.summary: An include shows part of another page from this site in this one, loaded at once, when idle or when scrolled into view.

ui-input.title: Input
ui-input.summary: An input is a field used to elicit a response from a user.

ui-textarea.title: Textarea
ui-textarea.summary: A textarea is a multi-line field used to elicit a longer response.

ui-item.title: Item
ui-item.summary: One item for dropdowns, lists and menus, rendered by whatever holds it.

ui-items.title: Items
ui-items.summary: A group of items presents a set of site content for display, each an image beside its text.

ui-list.title: List
ui-list.summary: A list is used to group related content.

ui-loader.title: Loader
ui-loader.summary: A loader alerts a user to wait for an activity to complete.

ui-markdown.title: Markdown
ui-markdown.summary: Markdown renders GitHub-flavoured markdown -- tables, task lists, code blocks -- from the element's own text or a file on this site.

ui-menu.title: Menu
ui-menu.summary: A menu displays grouped navigation actions.

defaults.--ui-menu-active-first-radius: the menu's own corners on that side (by layout)
defaults.--ui-menu-active-last-radius: the menu's own corners on that side (by layout)

ui-message.title: Message
ui-message.summary: A message displays information that explains nearby content.

ui-modal.title: Modal
ui-modal.summary: A modal displays content that temporarily blocks interactions with the main view of a site.

defaults.--ui-modal-width: 95%;  tablets 88%;  then 850px / 900px / 950px by screen (scaled by size)

ui-nag.title: Nag
ui-nag.summary: A nag is a persistent message that stays until dismissed, and can remember the dismissal.

ui-panel.title: Panel
ui-panel.summary: A panel is an inspector:  a tinted box of fields under a header band, with sub-head bands that fold.

ui-parts.title: Content parts
ui-parts.summary: Headers, content, descriptions, metas and the other generic parts that cards, items, modals and messages share.

ui-actions.title: Actions
ui-actions.summary: Actions hold what a user can do next:  a comment's reply links, a modal's or toast's buttons.

ui-author.title: Author
ui-author.summary: An author names who wrote a comment or did a feed event.

ui-avatar.title: Avatar
ui-avatar.summary: An avatar is a small picture of a person, beside a comment, an item or a card.

ui-content.title: Content
ui-content.summary: Content is the main block of a card, item, feed event, comment, modal, message, list item or step.

ui-date.title: Date
ui-date.summary: A date says when something happened, inline and small inside a feed event.

ui-description.title: Description
ui-description.summary: A description is the text of a card, item, modal, list item, step or comment.

ui-detail.title: Detail
ui-detail.summary: A detail is a label's dimmer second value, such as a count.

ui-extra.title: Extra
ui-extra.summary: Extra content is set apart from the main content, such as a card's footer.

ui-meta.title: Meta
ui-meta.summary: A meta holds metadata about the content, such as a date or a category.

ui-summary.title: Summary
ui-summary.summary: A summary is a feed event's main line:  who did what, and when.

ui-title.title: Title
ui-title.summary: A title heads a step, an accordion panel or a search result.

ui-value.title: Value
ui-value.summary: A value is what a statistic shows:  a number, a word, an icon or an image.

ui-placeholder.title: Placeholder
ui-placeholder.summary: A placeholder is used to reserve space for content that soon will appear in a layout.

ui-popup.title: Popup
ui-popup.summary: A popup displays additional information on top of a page.

ui-progress.title: Progress
ui-progress.summary: A progress bar shows the progression of a task.

ui-rail.title: Rail
ui-rail.summary: A rail is used to show accompanying content outside the boundaries of the main view of a site.

ui-rating.title: Rating
ui-rating.summary: A rating indicates user interest in content.

ui-reveal.title: Reveal
ui-reveal.summary: A reveal displays additional content in place of previous content when activated.

ui-root.title: Root
ui-root.summary: A root loads the components inside it on demand, sets their theme, size, icons and emoji, and shows them once they're ready.

ui-search.title: Search
ui-search.summary: A search module allows a user to query for results from a selection of data.

ui-section.title: Section
ui-section.summary: A section is a titled block of content that can fold away and keep its title in view.

ui-segment.title: Segment
ui-segment.summary: A segment is used to create a grouping of related content.

ui-select.title: Select
ui-select.summary: A select lets a user choose a value from a list, with the platform's own picker.

ui-shape.title: Shape
ui-shape.summary: A shape is a three dimensional object displayed on a two dimensional plane.

list.name: --ui-shape-cube-size
list.description: Width and height of a cube's faces.

list.name: --ui-shape-cube-background
list.default: light grey (dark grey in dark mode)

list.name: --ui-shape-cube-shadow
list.description: Colour of a cube face's thin shadow.

ui-sidebar.title: Sidebar
ui-sidebar.summary: A sidebar hides additional content beside a page.

ui-slider.title: Slider
ui-slider.summary: A slider allows users to select values within a range.

ui-statistic.title: Statistic
ui-statistic.summary: A statistic emphasizes the current value of an attribute.

ui-step.title: Step
ui-step.summary: A step shows the completion status of an activity in a series of activities.

ui-sticky.title: Sticky
ui-sticky.summary: Sticky content stays fixed to the viewport while its container is on screen.

ui-tab.title: Tab
ui-tab.summary: A tab is a hidden section of content activated by a menu.

ui-table.title: Table
ui-table.summary: A table displays a collection of data grouped into rows.

ui-text.title: Text
ui-text.summary: A text is used to style some inline text with a simple color.

ui-toast.title: Toast
ui-toast.summary: A toast allows users to receive a short, non-blocking notification.

ui-transition.title: Transition
ui-transition.summary: A transition is an animation used to show or hide content, or to draw attention to it.

ui-tree-diagram.title: Tree diagram
ui-tree-diagram.summary: A tree diagram draws a tree top-down:  a box for each node, a line to each of its children.

ui-visibility.title: Visibility
ui-visibility.summary: Visibility provides a set of callbacks for when content appears in the viewport.
